title: selliguea pothifolia
intro: Selliguea pothifolia, commonly known as Polynesian Shield Fern, is a species of fern native to Southeast Asia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and treating various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Selliguea pothifolia include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The health benefits of this plant include its potential to protect against oxidative stress, improve immune function, and promote wound healing, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
